mapper.select: select i.INSURANCE_ID, i.INSURANCE_TYPE, (select meaning from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'NEW_INSURANCE_TYPE' and code_value = i.INSURANCE_TYPE) as insuranceTypeN, i.INSURANCE_DATE_FROM, i.INSURANCE_DATE_TO, i.INSURANCE_COMPANY, i.INSURANCE_NUMBER, i.INSURANCE_AMOUNT, i.FIRST_BENEFICIARY, i.CREATION_DATE, i.PROJECT_LEASE_ITEM_ID, i.COMPULSORY_AMOUNT, decode(i.IS_COMPULSORY_INSURANCE,'1','是','2','否',' ') IS_COMPULSORY_INSURANCE, i.COMPULSORY_END_DATE, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'ABS.PROJECT_STATUS' and scv.value = i.COMMERCIAL_INSURANCE) COMMERCIAL_INSURANCE, i.EXTENDED_WARRANTY_AMOUNT, decode(i.IS_VEHICLE_DAMAGE,'1','是','2','否',' ') IS_VEHICLE_DAMAGE, i.VEHICLE_END_DATE, decode(i.IS_THIRD_PARTY,'1','是','2','否',' ') IS_THIRD_PARTY, i.THIRD_END_DATE from PRJ_LEASE_ITEM_INSURANCE i where i.PROJECT_LEASE_ITEM_ID = #{projectLeaseItemId} order by i.INSURANCE_DATE_FROM asc

select * from (select t1.insurance_id, t3.project_id, t3.project_number, t3.project_name, t3.project_status, t2.full_name, t1.insurance_type, (select meaning from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'NEW_INSURANCE_TYPE' and code_value = t1.insurance_type) as insurance_type_n, t1.insurance_date_from, t1.insurance_date_to, t1.insurance_company, t1.insurance_number, t1.insurance_amount, t1.first_beneficiary, t1.COMPULSORY_AMOUNT, decode(t1.IS_COMPULSORY_INSURANCE,,'1','是','2','否',' ') IS_COMPULSORY_INSURANCE, t1.COMPULSORY_END_DATE, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'ABS.PROJECT_STATUS' and scv.value = i.COMMERCIAL_INSURANCE) COMMERCIAL_INSURANCE, t1.EXTENDED_WARRANTY_AMOUNT, decode(t1.IS_VEHICLE_DAMAGE,'1','是','2','否',' ') IS_VEHICLE_DAMAGE, t1.VEHICLE_END_DATE, decode(t1.IS_THIRD_PARTY,'1','是','2','否',' ') IS_THIRD_PARTY, t1.THIRD_END_DATE from prj_project_lease_item t2 inner join prj_project t3 on t2.project_id = t3.project_id left join prj_lease_item_insurance t1 on t1.project_lease_item_id = t2.project_lease_item_id where t3.document_type in ('PRJL', 'PRJLB') and t2.full_name is not null) v
and v.project_number like concat('%', concat(#{projectNumber,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.project_name like concat('%', concat(#{projectName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.full_name like concat('%', concat(#{fullName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.insurance_type like concat('%', concat(#{insuranceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.insurance_date_from >= to_date(#{insuranceDateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and v.insurance_date_to <= to_date(#{insuranceDateTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and v.insurance_company like concat('%', concat(#{insuranceCompany,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.insurance_number like concat('%', concat(#{insuranceNumber,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.INSURANCE_AMOUNT = #{insuranceAmount}
and v.first_beneficiary like concat('%', concat(#{firstBeneficiary,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
order by v.project_id desc

select count(i.INSURANCE_ID) from PRJ_LEASE_ITEM_INSURANCE i where i.INSURANCE_NUMBER = #{insuranceNumber} and not exists (select 1 from prj_project pp, prj_project_lease_item it where pp.project_id = it.project_id and it.project_lease_item_id = i.project_lease_item_id and pp.project_status = 'CLOSED') and not exists (select 1 from prj_project pp, prj_project_lease_item it, con_contract cc where pp.project_id = it.project_id and it.project_lease_item_id = i.project_lease_item_id and cc.project_id = pp.project_id and cc.contract_status = 'CANCEL')
select t.* from prj_lease_item_insurance t, prj_project_lease_item pi where pi.project_lease_item_id = t.project_lease_item_id and pi.project_id = #{projectId}
select PLII.* from PRJ_LEASE_ITEM_INSURANCE PLII where PLII.PROJECT_LEASE_ITEM_ID = #{projectLeaseItemId}
